quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on the Timberwolves' playoff run and team values
quotes.excerpt: I'm still very proud of the group, very proud of the values we showed and we learn.
quotes.quote: I think that each person has their own way of dealing with it. Personally, it is true that there is always disappointment. The goal was the title, but I manage to relativize very quickly and take the lessons. Take the lessons to come back stronger and try to always see the positive.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Je pense que chacun a sa manière de gérer ça. Moi personnellement, c'est vrai que il y a toujours la déception. Le but c'était le titre, mais j'arrive très rapidement quand même à relativiser et à utiliser, prendre les leçons. Prendre les leçons pour revenir plus fort et puis essayer de prendre toujours voir le positif quand même.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on his defensive challenge against Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: I know that I have to really defend him one-on-one, whatever happens.
quotes.quote: We played them in the bubble, and we played them three other times, so it's the fourth series against Jokic. I think it's the series where I was mentally the most ready to face him. I know that I have to really defend him one-on-one, whatever happens. And I knew that I would have to get out of my comfort zone a little bit, but it became a comfort zone to put pressure all over the court, to do things that I had never done before, and it paid off in the end.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: On les a joués dans la bulle, et on les a joués trois autres fois, donc c'est la quatrième série contre Jokic. Je pense que c'est la série où j'étais mentalement le plus prêt à l'affronter. C'est-à-dire que là, je sais que je dois vraiment le défendre one-on-one, quoi qu'il arrive. Et je savais que je devrais sortir de ma zone de confort un petit peu, mais c'est devenu une zone de confort de mettre la pression tout terrain, de faire des choses que j'avais jamais faites en vrai avant, et ça a payé au final.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on his leadership role and inspiring teammates
quotes.excerpt: I'm in a moment where I prepared myself psychologically to really carry the team.
quotes.quote: I'm in a moment where I prepared myself psychologically to really carry the team, while being the best version of myself. And I knew that by doing that, I could inspire my teammates to be themselves and behind that to inspire the team to win, simply because that's where it starts. For me, leadership is when few people believe, to be the one who allows others to believe in fact.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Disons que ouais, j'étais dans un moment où je me suis préparé psychologiquement à vraiment porter l'équipe, en étant la meilleure version de moi-même. Et je savais qu'en faisant ça, je pouvais inspirer mes coéquipiers à être eux-mêmes et derrière à inspirer l'équipe à gagner tout simplement parce que c'est de là que ça part. Pour moi, le leadership, c'est quand peu de gens y croient, être celui qui permet aux autres d'y croire en fait.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on his defensive game plan against Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: The goal was really not to make unnecessary fouls.
quotes.quote: The goal was really not to make unnecessary fouls. If he makes shots, if he makes contested shots, it's okay. But taking away his easy shots, taking away his comfort, making him uncomfortable, and especially trying to wear him down physically. It's a bit the same strategy against all great players. The goal is to wear them down over time, simply because you know that on a possession, they can do incredible things, but over time, if you manage to wear them down, you can try to limit them.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Le but c'était vraiment de pas faire de fautes inutiles. Si s'il met des tirs, s'il met des shoots contestés, c'est OK. Mais lui enlever ses tirs faciles, lui enlever son confort, lui rendre inconfortable, et surtout essayer de l'user physiquement. C'est un peu la même stratégie contre tous les grands joueurs. Le but c'est de les user sur la durée, tout simplement parce que tu sais que sur une possession, ils peuvent faire des choses incroyables, mais sur la durée, si tu arrives à les user, tu peux essayer de les limiter.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on ignoring social media criticism during playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I was really focused on the objective, and the objective was not only to beat Jokic.
quotes.quote: I was really focused on the objective, and the objective was not only to beat Jokic, it was to be champion. So it was really to be focused on each match, on the present moment, and I didn't really realize what was happening on the networks.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Donc voilà, j'étais vraiment concentré sur l'objectif, et l'objectif c'était pas seulement de battre Jokic, c'était d'être champion. Donc c'était vraiment d'être focus sur chaque match, sur le moment présent, et je me rendais pas vraiment compte de ce qui se passait sur les réseaux.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on media bias and negative narratives
quotes.excerpt: These big media in addition tend to show more negative things than positive things about me.
quotes.quote: Unfortunately, today the opinion of the majority of fans is based on that in fact. It's based on what when they go on Instagram, they see videos and they see what the big media say, and I, it's true that these big media in addition tend to show more negative things than positive things about me. So necessarily, I am not surprised.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Malheureusement, aujourd'hui l'opinion de la majorité des fans est basée sur ça en fait. C'est basée sur ce quand ils vont sur Instagram, ils voient des vidéos et ils voient ce dont les les gros médias parlent, tu vois et et moi c'est vrai que ces gros médias en plus ont tendance à me montrer des choses plus négatives que les choses positives à mon égard. Donc forcément, je ne suis pas surpris.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on his reaction to Shaquille O'Neal's criticism
quotes.excerpt: It's an entertainer, you know, when he's on the set, he's there to play a role.
quotes.quote: It's an entertainer, you know, when he's on the set, he's there to play a role. And it's true that if there are three people who criticize someone, he might want to be the one who calms things down, you know. So I take it more personally. And I will always be happy for the people who sign very big contracts, for all the young players, if they sign contracts for 500 million, at some point, I will be the first to be happy for them.

quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on his personal growth and ignoring outside opinions

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on the difficulty of the Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: The road was Denver, probably San Antonio and probably Oklahoma City.
quotes.quote: Already, it's true that before, from the moment we knew we were playing Denver, we knew that the road was Denver, probably San Antonio and probably Oklahoma City. And then for the final, and then probably the best team in the East. We didn't know who it would be. And already statistically, it would have been the hardest, the path the hardest in the history of the entire NBA, statistically in fact, on the analytics and all that. And so I saw that as an opportunity, and that's what I said to the guys.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Déjà, c'est vrai qu'avant, à partir du moment où on a su qu'on jouait Denver, on a su que la route c'était Denver, probablement San Antonio et probablement Oklahoma City. Et puis pour la finale, et puis probablement la meilleure équipe de l'Est. On savait pas qui ça allait être. Et déjà statistiquement, ça aurait été le plus dur, le parcours le plus dur de l'histoire de toute la NBA, statistiquement en fait, sur les analytics et tout ça. Et donc moi j'ai vu ça comme une opportunité, et c'est ce que je disais aux gars.
